categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Kehui Power Automation Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: intelligent power grid fault monitoring and automation products, switched reluctance motor (SRM) drive systems, and energy storage systems including integrated photovoltaic-storage solutions. The company focuses on R&D, production, and sales of electrical automation and industrial IoT technologies, serving power systems, railway systems, and various industrial sectors such as textile and forging machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including wide-area traveling wave fault location, transient signal acquisition without dead zones, AI-based fault diagnosis, high-sensitivity grounding fault protection, and advanced motor control algorithms for switched and synchronous reluctance motors. Manufacturing emphasizes integrated mechatronic design, digital and intelligent upgrades, and modular, standardized production. The R&D approach includes a technical committee guiding strategic innovation and rigorous testing protocols.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, railway enterprises like China National Railway Group, and industrial clients in textile, forging, mining, and petrochemical sectors. The company’s products are widely applied in power transmission and distribution, railway electrification, and industrial motor drive applications, with growing penetration in user-side energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales and project deployments covering multiple provinces including Shandong, Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and others. Its products are also exported to over 30 countries and regions internationally. Subsidiaries and branches are located in cities such as Zibo, Jinan, Qingdao, Nantong, Hangzhou, and Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Kehui operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the electrical equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and direct sales of power automation equipment, motor drive systems, and energy storage solutions. It engages in procurement of electronic components and raw materials but emphasizes in-house R&D and production capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent power grid fault detection, automation, and energy storage technologies aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals. R&D focuses on upgrading core products with AI, 5G/6G communications, edge computing, and industrial internet integration. It actively develops high-efficiency switched and synchronous reluctance motors, user-side energy storage systems, and virtual power plant technologies to expand market applications and improve energy efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized electrical automation products, motor drive systems, and energy storage equipment. The company also earns income from technical services, maintenance, and integrated energy solutions. Sales are predominantly conducted via direct sales channels, including bidding and negotiation with large institutional customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in intelligent power grid fault monitoring and switched reluctance motor drive systems, with market share exceeding 65% in SRM drives. Its products compete with international first-tier firms like Siemens, ABB, and Schneider Electric in automation and motor control sectors. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion' in key product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 420 million, a 22.13% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 30.5 million, up 139.79%. R&D investment accounted for 11.5% of revenue. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding market penetration and improving profitability, supported by strong cash flows and a solid asset base of over RMB 805 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shandong Kehui emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high precision fault detection, and automation capabilities that enhance power grid reliability and efficiency. Its switched reluctance motors offer energy-saving advantages without reliance on rare earth materials, supporting sustainable development. The company’s integrated energy storage and smart energy management systems provide flexible, intelligent solutions tailored to user-side needs, differentiating it through innovation, customization, and strong after-sales service.
